-- For product 4280:
-- loc 65 (C,1): qty 36, purchased 2018-02-23
-- loc 114 (D,18): qty 39, purchased 2018-04-23
-- loc 4 (A,4): qty 37, purchased 2018-10-23
--
-- Order qty for 4280 = 60
-- Pick from loc 65: min(36, 60-0) = 36, remaining = 24
-- Pick from loc 114: min(39, 60-36) = min(39, 24) = 24, remaining = 0
-- Total = 36 + 24 = 60 ✓
--
-- The final result is:
-- Product 4280:
--   Aisle C, Position 1, pick 36
--   Aisle D, Position 18, pick 24
-- Product 6520:
--   Aisle A, Position 16, pick 6
--   Aisle A, Position 29, pick 14
--   Aisle C, Position 13, pick 20

-- One more check - make sure pick_qty is displayed properly (as integer if possible)
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT id, order_id, product_id, qty as order_qty
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_wh1 AS (
    SELECT inv.id as inv_id, inv.product_id, inv.qty as inv_qty, 
           inv.location_id, loc.warehouse, loc.aisle, loc.position,
           p.purchased
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN locations loc ON inv.location_id = loc.id
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE loc.warehouse = 1
),
ranked_inventory AS (
    SELECT inv_id, product_id, inv_qty, location_id, warehouse, aisle, position, purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased ASC, inv_qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inventory_wh1
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT ri.*, 
           SUM(ri.inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ri.product_id ORDER BY ri.purchased ASC, ri.inv_qty ASC) as cum_inv
    FROM ranked_inventory ri
),
order_cumulative AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, ol.order_qty,
           SUM(ol.order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_order
    FROM order_lines ol
),
pick_calc AS (
    SELECT c.*,
           oc.order_qty,
           COALESCE(LAG(c.cum_inv) OVER (PARTITION BY c.product_id ORDER BY c.purchased ASC, c.inv_qty ASC), 0) as prev_cum_inv
    FROM cumulative c
    JOIN order_cumulative oc ON c.product_id = oc.product_id
),
final_pick AS (
    SELECT product_id, location_id, aisle, position,
           LEAST(inv_qty, GREATEST(0.0, order_qty - prev_cum_inv)) as pick_qty
    FROM pick_calc
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, CAST(pick_qty AS INTEGER) as pick_qty
FROM final_pick
WHERE pick_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, aisle, position

--   Location 69 (purchased 2018-06-26, qty 70): pick 0

    ORDER BY id
